```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="KHTRV02P473A" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Passage</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#KHTRV02P473A">KHTRV02P473A</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-KHTR" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>al-Khaṭīb al-Baghdādī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Tālī Talkhīṣ al-mutashābih fī al-rasm</span></a>, vol. 2 p. 473</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    أخبرني أبو القاسم علي بن محمد بن علي بن يعقوب الإيادي حدثنا أبو بكر محمد بن عبد الله بن إبراهيم الشافعي إملاء حدثنا إسماعيل بن محمد بن أبي كثير القاضي الفارسي حدثنا شهاب بن معمر البلخي حدثنا أبو يحيى بكر بن سليمان الأسواري عن ابن إسحاق قال حدثني عاصم بن عمر بن قتادة عن محمود بن لبيد عن عبد الله بن عباس قال حدثني سلمان الفارسي من فيه قال كنت رجلا فارسيا من أهل أصبهان من أهل قرية منها يقال لها جي وكان أبي يقال له دهقان قريته وذكر حديث إسلام سلمان الفارسي بطوله. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 473 of vol. 2">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```
```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="THRXV21P178A" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Passage</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#THRXV21P178A">THRXV21P178A</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-THRX" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Ibn al-Athīr</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Usd al-ghābah fī maʿrifat al-ṣaḥābah</span></a>, vol. 21 p. 178</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    أخبرنا أبو غالب الماوردي أنا أبو الحسن السيرافي أنا أحمد بن إسحاق نا أحمد بن عمران نا موسى بن زكريا نا خليفة بن خياط نا بكر بن سليمان عن ابن إسحاق عن سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن حسان بن ثابت قال توفي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو ابن ثلاث وستين. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 178 of vol. 21">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```
```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="BKHBV01P130A" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Passage</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#BKHBV01P130A">BKHBV01P130A</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-BKHB" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm al-Bukhārī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh al-kabīr</span></a>, vol. 1 p. 130</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    حدثنا بكر بن سليمان قال أخبرنا ابن إسحاق قال حدثني محمد بن عبد الله بن قيس ابن مخرمة عن الحسن بن محمد بن علي عن أبيه محمد عن جده علي قال سمعت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ما هممت بشئ مما كان أهل الجاهلية يعملون به غير مرتين كل ذلك يحول الله بيني وبينه ما هممت بعدهما حتى أكرمني الله برسالته. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 130 of vol. 1">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```
```{=html}
<article class="sira-report" id="HYKUV03P129C" lang="ar" dir="rtl">
  <header class="sira-report-header" lang="en" dir="ltr">
    <span class="report-label">Passage</span>
    <a class="report-id" href="#HYKUV03P129C">HYKUV03P129C</a>
    <div class="sira-source-line" lang="en" dir="ltr"><span class="source-label">Source:</span> <a href="../references.html#ref-HYKU" class="source-link"><span class='ref-author'>Nūr al-Dīn ʿAlī b. Abī Bakr Haythamī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Kashf al-astār ʿan zawāʾid al-Bazzār</span></a>, vol. 3 p. 129</div>
  </header>
  <div class="witness-text">
    حدثنا موسى بن عبد الله أبو طلحة الخزاعي ثنا بكر بن سليمان ثنا محمد بن إسحاق حدثني محمد بن عبد الله بن قيس بن مخرمة عن الحسن بن محمد بن علي عن أبيه محمد بن علي عن جده علي بن أبي طالب قال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ما هممت بشيء مما كان أهل الجاهلية يعملون به غير مرتين كل ذلك يحول الله بيني وبين ما أريد من ذلك ثم ما هممت بعدها بشيء حتى أكرمني الله برسالته. <span class="page-no" title="end of page 129 of vol. 3">§</span>
  </div>
</article>
```
```{=html}
</div>
```

[^comment-SFTXV01P138C-1]: This fragment is not found in HSNX. It recounts how ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb distribute charity during the Year of the Drought (Ramādah), which occurred in the year 18 during a major drought (see <a href="../references.html#ref-SFTX" class="source-ref">SFTXV01P138C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ al-Shaybānī al-ʿAṣfarī</span>, <span class='ref-title'>Taʾrīkh</span>, vol. 1 p. 138)). Also see <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī), <a href="WABAW.html" class="witness-link">WABAW</a> (ʿAbbād b. al-ʿAwwām al-Kilābī al-Wāsiṭī), <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī), and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) for a reference to the event.
[^comment-SFTXV01P092A-1]: A similar passage is found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P500C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 500) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P500G</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 500) but with a different order. The HSNX section is divided into four seperate statements from Ibn Isḥāq although Ibn Hishām inserted comments into the passage resulting in multiple statements beginning with &quot;qāla Ibn Isḥāq.&quot; It is not known how the original text that al-Bakkāʾī relayed to Ibn Hishām may have been structured. A similar passage is also found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), although this too is structred in a slightly different form than each other as well as <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) and <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī). There is no mention of Fāṭimah bint al-Ḍaḥḥāk. Her father, al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. Sufyān al-Kilābī, is mentioned in three passages in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) as found in HSNX, once in the story of the Battle of Ḥunayn and twice in reference to the sack of al-Ṭāʾif. She is mentioned in a list of the prophet&#x27;s wides in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī).
[^comment-SFTXV01P086B-1]: This passage is similar to one located in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) (<a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P373C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 373)). Also see <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), in both the fragmentary form found in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī), and as a part of a much longer narrative. <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī) include versions that embed them in longer accounts similar to that found in <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī). The passage above is worded slightly differently from <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī).
[^comment-SFTXV01P087B-1]: This fragment is similar to that that found in <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) on <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV02P437C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 437) that closes the story of Khālid b. al-Walīd’s mission to destroy the image of al-ʿUzzā at Nakhlah, but includes reference to the year. It is part of a compund clause in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī). This clasue is also found as a stand alone fragments in <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) (see <a href="../references.html#ref-ZTKX" class="source-ref">ZTKXV01P096A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>Ibn Abī Khaythamah</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Tārīkh al-kabīr sifr al-thānī</span>, vol. 1 p. 96)). A similar passage is also found in <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī) and <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī). Placement based on initial reference in the first clause.

[^comment-SFTXV01P080A-1]: <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī) includes a similar story in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV2P294D</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 294) to <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV2P295A</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 2 p. 295) in the story of the Raid on the Banū al-Muṣṭaliq and the Prophet&#x27;s marriage to Jūwayrīyah bint al-Ḥārith in a narrative structure much like that found in <a href="WSFAB.html" class="witness-link">WSFAB</a> (Salamah b. al-Faḍl al-Abrash al-Azraqī al-Anṣārī al-Rāzī), <a href="WYBWS.html" class="witness-link">WYBWS</a> (Yūnus b. Bukayr b. Wāṣil al-Shaybānī al-Jamāl al-Kūfī), <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī), <a href="WSSAA.html" class="witness-link">WSSAA</a> (Ṣadaqah b. Sābiq al-Muqʿad), <a href="WAMAQ.html" class="witness-link">WAMAQ</a> (ʿAlī b. Mushir al-Kūfī al-Qurashī), and <a href="WJHZA.html" class="witness-link">WJHZA</a> (Jarīr b. Ḥāzim b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Shajāʿ al-Azdī al-ʿAtkī al-Baṣrī). <a href="WMSAH.html" class="witness-link">WMSAH</a> (Muḥammad b. Salamah b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Bāhilī al-Ḥarrānī) also witnessed an account completely unlike his other version and unlike other versions. The story related by <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī) is narratively different and more similar to that found in <a href="WAIYA.html" class="witness-link">WAIYA</a> (ʿAbd Allāh b. Idrīs b. Yazīd al-Awdī al-Zaʿāfarī). <a href="WZAZA.html" class="witness-link">WZAZA</a> (Zakarīyā b. Abī Zāʾidah) also relates the story with yet another narrative structure. <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) produced a truncated version. <a href="WAKMW.html" class="witness-link">WAKMW</a> (Aḥmad b. Khālid b. Mūsā al-Wahbī al-Kindī) witnessed a tradition that lists Jūwayrīyah bint al-Ḥārith as an eyewitness not found in other witnesses.
[^comment-KHLSV02P376B-1]: Similar passage found in <a href="../references.html#ref-HSNX" class="source-ref">HSNXV01P638C</a> (<span class='ref-author'>ʿAbd al-Malik b. Hishām</span>, <span class='ref-title'>al-Sīrah al-Nabuwīyah</span>, vol. 1 p. 638) in the aftermath of Badr when Muḥammad orders the death among the attacking Quraysh be thrown into a pit, the so-called &quot;prayer of the people of the pit.&quot; In addition to <a href="WZATB.html" class="witness-link">WZATB</a> (Ziyād b. ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Ṭufayl al-Kūfī al-Bakkāʾī al-ʿĀmirī), the passage is also found in <a href="WBSAB.html" class="witness-link">WBSAB</a> (Bakr b. Sulaymān al-Aswārī al-Baṣrī) and <a href="WSACD.html" class="witness-link">WSACD</a> (Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Madinī al-Zuhrī).
